    Fischbacher §5.3: the new segments from a chain of arrows #

    A chain of links ε₀ → ε₁ → ⋯ → ε_m out of c, with bounds ε_{i-1} x_i = ε_i y_i at e_i, together with a path v : f₀ ⇝ dl and a path w : f_m ⇝ d, gives the segment list (v, w₁), (v₁, w₂), …, (v_m, w) from dl to d with peaks e_i (segsOf), where w_i and v_i are paths with values x_i and y_i. This is the replacement of t⁻¹ s in §5.3.
